purpose: Entirely new CatOS village artwork and independent animation layers
notes: Legacy home-world-v1.png was used only as palette/style reference for the first concept. All new home bodies and parts were generated independently from the new concept; no legacy house crops were made.
Original PNGs are preserved. WebP derivatives were encoded with cwebp at q91 with alpha_q100; runtime dimensions are recorded in asset-audit.json.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Deliver a completely newly painted MASTER ENVIRONMENT CONCEPT for CatOS, portrait 1536x2048, a premium cozy fantasy learning village designed for an Android game. Input image is a PALETTE / PAINTERLY MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY. Invent every building, terrain contour, river, garden and composition from scratch. DO NOT reuse the reference buildings, crop buildings, copy its silhouettes, paste photographic cutouts, or recreate its circular composition.

ART: beautifully hand-painted gouache storybook / miniature diorama, convincing elevated three-quarter 2.5D view, consistent camera roughly 35 degrees above ground, visible roofs and front/right walls. Sage and olive woodland, muted warm sandstone, honey oak beams, blue slate and muted terracotta accents, warm soft late-afternoon sun from upper left. Natural contact shadows, building foundations settled into ground, layered forest depth, low terraces, subtle atmospheric distance. Gentle realistic painterly textures rather than black outlines, flat vectors, over-detailed noise or plastic 3D.

COMPOSITION: tall continuous asymmetrical woodland valley, land fills the frame, no sky. This is a village the player travels THROUGH from bottom to top, not buildings encircling a plaza. Exactly EIGHT distinct learning destinations on naturally connected ground. Keep homes separated by generous clearings and broad meandering footpaths, not in rows or a circular ring. A winding geographical river descends along the eastern/right half, from upper right to bottom right, bends inland through midground. TWO bridges, one small arched stone bridge and one rustic timber bridge, connect the river banks. Calm irregular village green in the lower-middle with open ground for existing animated pets; no circular stone medallion. Use sparse selective gardens, rocks and lamps, abundant walkable space, clear silhouettes that read on a phone. No disconnected islands, round platforms, separate grassy pedestals, crowded roofs, continuous edge-to-edge flowers or decorative paths that vanish under clutter.

EXACT DESTINATIONS, each a fresh design and all clearly visible, from bottom toward top:
1 lower LEFT around (24% width,82% height): CHAI'S READING LIBRARY, a substantial welcoming two-storey timber-and-stone library with an elongated wing, blue slate gables, tall arched windows visibly containing books, open-book carving and tiny owl crest. NOT a generic round cottage.
2 lower RIGHT around (68%,77%): MATCHA'S BOTANICAL GLASSHOUSE, fresh tall glass-and-honey-oak conservatory with a ridge vent, nursery benches and ferns visible inside, restrained vegetable beds.
3 middle LEFT around (34%,64%): GINGER'S RAILWAY WORKSHOP, a warm red-roofed tiny depot/atelier, clock over the station doorway, a short rail spur and two small wooden book-like carriages beside it. Railway must read as a village-scale learning workshop, not a huge locomotive.
4 middle RIGHT around (74%,54%): MALLOW'S SKY OBSERVATORY, an airy indigo/verdigris dome, brass telescope and star-window, on a gentle natural hillside beside a bridge.
5 middle LEFT around (22%,44%): MOCHI'S PANTRY COTTAGE, cozy sage-roofed stone kitchen home, deep windows showing preserves jars and neatly arranged pantry shelves, a small herb bed. NO archery targets.
6 upper-middle around (54%,33%): BISCUIT'S LONG-TABLE COTTAGE, a welcoming rose-accented timber dining hall with a long table visible through a wide open arched window, a few chairs and a short veranda.
7 upper LEFT around (30%,18%): SESAME'S CLOCKWORK HOUSE, slim whimsical pale-stone clock tower joined to a modest brass-cog workshop, blue-gray slate roof, clock face and gear window.
8 upper RIGHT around (70%,12%): TOFFEE'S HEARTH LODGE AND FINAL CAMP CLEARING, a small open-sided oak lodge with a campfire ring and spaced log seats in front, warm lanterns, open gathering area. This should be ONE destination, not an extra ninth house.

PATH STORY: winding broad lanes connect these eight destinations as an ascending journey. Clear door approaches for character movement. River may be crossed by bridges; no house stands in water. Buildings must share one coherent architectural family and belong physically to this same landscape, not look like unrelated stickers. No characters or pets baked into the illustration (existing animated pets added later). No game UI, words, numbers, badges, progress icons, labels or text. No watermark. Full-bleed finished environmental artwork, not a sketch, moodboard or asset collage.
